-- PRAGMA_END


-- IMPORT_BEGIN
import Intro.Asset
-- IMPORT_END

template AssetHolderInvite
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
  where
    signatory issuer
    observer owner

    choice AssetHolderInvite_Accept
      : ContractId AssetHolder
      controller owner
      do
        create AssetHolder with
          issuer
          owner

template AssetHolder
  with
    issuer : Party
    owner : Party
  where
    signatory issuer, owner

    nonconsuming choice Issue_Asset
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        symbol : Text
        quantity : Decimal
      controller issuer
      do
        create Asset with
          issuer
          owner
          symbol
          quantity
          observers = []

    nonconsuming choice Accept_Transfer
      : ContractId Asset
      with
        transferProposalCid : ContractId TransferProposal
      controller owner
      do
        exercise transferProposalCid TransferProposal_Accept

    nonconsuming choice Preapprove_Transfer
      : ContractId TransferApproval
      with
        asset : Asset
      controller owner
      do
        create TransferApproval with
          asset
          newOwner = owner

module Test.Intro.Asset.Role where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role

setupRoles = do
  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
  usdbank <- allocateParty "USD_Bank"

  ahia <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = alice

  ahib <- submit usdbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = usdbank
      owner = bob

  aha <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd ahia AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  ahb <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd ahib AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  return (alice, bob, usdbank, aha, ahb)

-- TEST_ISSUANCE_BEGIN
test_issuance = do
  setupResult@(alice, bob, bank, aha, ahb) <- setupRoles

  assetCid <- submit bank do
    exerciseCmd aha Issue_Asset
      with
        symbol = "USD"
        quantity = 100.0

  Some asset <- queryContractId bank assetCid
  assert (asset == Asset with
      issuer = bank
      owner = alice
      symbol = "USD"
      quantity = 100.0
      observers = []
        )

  return (setupResult, assetCid)
-- TEST_ISSUANCE_END

module Test.Intro.Asset.Trade where

import Daml.Script

import Intro.Asset
import Intro.Asset.Role
import Intro.Asset.Trade

import Test.Intro.Asset.Role

tradeSetup = do
  (setupResult@(alice, bob, usdbank, usdha, usdhb), usdCid) <- test_issuance
  eurbank <- allocateParty "EUR_Bank"

  eurhia <- submit eurbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = eurbank
      owner = alice

  eurhib <- submit eurbank do
    createCmd AssetHolderInvite with
      issuer = eurbank
      owner = bob

  eurha <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd eurhia AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  eurhb <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd eurhib AssetHolderInvite_Accept

  eurCid <- submit eurbank do
    exerciseCmd eurhb Issue_Asset with
      symbol = "EUR"
      quantity = 90.0

  return (alice, bob, usdbank, eurbank, usdha, usdhb, eurha, eurhb, usdCid, eurCid)


test_trade = do
  (alice, bob, usdbank, eurbank, usdha, usdhb, eurha, eurhb, usdCid, eurCid) <- tradeSetup

  -- Alice wants to swap her 100 USD for Bob's 90 EUR

  -- First, she has to show her USD to bob and get pre-approval for the transfer of EUR
  let
    eur = Asset with
      issuer = eurbank
      owner = bob
      symbol = "EUR"
      quantity = 90.0
      observers = []
-- SET_OBSERVER_BEGIN
  usdCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd usdCid SetObservers with
      newObservers = [bob]
-- SET_OBSERVER_END
  eurtaCid <- submit alice do
    exerciseCmd eurha Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = eur

  -- Now she can createCmd the trade
  Some usd <- queryContractId alice usdCid
  tradeCid <- submit alice do
    createCmd Trade with
      baseAssetCid = usdCid
      baseAsset = usd
      quoteApprovalCid = eurtaCid
      quoteAsset = eur

  -- Bob accepts by supplying a transfer approval for the uas and his eur.
  Some usd <- queryContractId bob usdCid
  usdtaCid <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd usdhb Preapprove_Transfer with
      asset = usd
  (usdCid, eurCid) <- submit bob do
    exerciseCmd tradeCid Trade_Settle with
      quoteAssetCid = eurCid
      baseApprovalCid = usdtaCid

  Some eur <- queryContractId eurbank eurCid
  assert (eur.owner == alice)

  Some usd <- queryContractId usdbank usdCid
  assert (usd.owner == bob)
